owner_requirements: LFM3_RECIPE_20261028.md data curation (35/20/15/15/15) and the owner's 2026-10-28 prioritization: most diverse, deepest-call-graph, most natlang-centric and Neuralese-using samples first; directory reducers count toward tier 1 with their own family cap; single joint natlang + Neuralese stage; held/dev never train.
sample: one native graph row: a whole-trajectory chain or a program-header decision (renders), a verified teacher action turn (teacher twins), or a producer/consumer graph (communication); call-graph features are those of the sample's whole source trajectory

features.verified: every decision of the sample has an accepted root outcome with an accepted oracle where recorded (communication graphs: their source e2e cohort rows' outcome)
features.invocations: distinct natlang invocations of the trajectory
features.max_depth: longest parent chain (root = 0) over host-captured parent edges
features.max_branching: most child invocations of one invocation
features.distinct_functions: distinct called functions (signature name + normalized instructions)
features.natlang_idioms: decisions using awaited nl, per-item nl, iterateOn, decide or callable folders
features.natlang_action_share: characters of natlang program actions (eval code, typed return_result, runtime tools) over all output characters of the trajectory (a character proxy for assistant tokens)
features.neuralese_edges: producer->consumer edges in the graph row (genuine native Neuralese)
features.text_neuralese_markers: text-emulated Neuralese marker spans in teacher actions (emulation, not native state)
features.reducer: directory-reducer use: reducer kind/modality or Folder first parameter; with folder_apply_calls and reducer_iterate_cursor
features.near_duplicate_cluster: sha256 of the root task's normalized instructions (digits -> 0, whitespace collapsed, first 400 chars)

drop_rules.reason: no natlang program structure (answer-only, plain QA or chat)
generic tool use or chat dominates the natlang actions

tiers.name: deep or branching, natlang idioms, Neuralese or reducer
deep or branching (or reducer) with natlang idioms
natlang idioms or typed natlang calls

ordering: tier 1 cohorts (and communication) carry training_priority 1: they are scheduled first (communication lane interleaved with the urgent lane); tiers 2-4 have priority 0 and follow in manifest order (tier 2 first)
weighting: category c keeps its allocation; inside it, tier t gets mass rows(t,c) * tier_weight(t) / sum_t' rows(t',c) * tier_weight(t'); each (tier, category) cell is written as round(mass / cohort_unit) equal cohort files, and own-outputs/1 family_balance (source-cohort) gives every cohort file equal loss mass
